chunks: He who hopes to meet God (should know) that God's appointed time will surely come. He is all-hearing and all-knowing.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to hope to meet God in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Intizar al-Faraj* (waiting for the reappearance), where believers actively prepare for their ultimate encounter with the Divine by cultivating spiritual readiness. The mention of God as 'The All-Hearing, The All-Knowing' underscores that this waiting is not passive but a conscious state of awareness, where every deed is recorded in anticipation of the final meeting.
